name: Audio Mix
description: Decides how far above the music bed the voice sits on this material, and turns that judgement into the per-window clip gain the render delivers.

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: State input: audio_spine (the timed audio spine with structure and music_behavior)

inputs.name: music_selection
inputs.description: State input: music_selection - the chosen bed. Read for `measurements`: a music_behavior is a RELATIVE dB applied to whatever level the file already carries, so the bed's own integrated loudness is what decides whether the planned offset lands.

inputs.name: a_roll_assignments
inputs.description: The source ranges the edit really plays, which is what makes the speech measurable: the BRIDGE runs one ffmpeg loudnorm pass per block over them and records speech_lufs (library/tools/speech_loudness.py). REQUIRED since 2026-09-16: without it the mix engineer is asked how far above the bed a voice should sit having been shown no voice, which is a judgement with half its arithmetic missing.

inputs.name: creative_direction
inputs.description: State input: creative_direction. Read by the ladder in library/tools/decided_value.py, which tries a value the direction really DECLARED before asking the model. No direction key states how loud music sits under a voice today, and the slot records that as the reason that rung is skipped rather than leaving it implicit.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: Path to the project folder. Read by the ladder for a preference the project STATES under pipeline.creative_preferences, which wins over the model's judgement (library/tools/decided_value.py).

outputs.name: bed_measurements
outputs.description: Bridge output: what the chosen bed measures - its own integrated loudness, loudness range, speech-band ratio and peaks - or the stated absence of a measurement. It is the table the prompt reads AND the measurement post_bridge.py solves the gain from, so the loudness passes run once and the two halves of the step cannot disagree.

outputs.name: mix_windows
outputs.description: Bridge output: one row per spine block in play order - the behaviour the spine planned, the measured speech loudness under it, and what separation the level the engine used to hold would deliver on this material. Declared for the same reason as bed_measurements.

outputs.name: mix_decision_legend
outputs.description: Bridge output: what each column IS and what a separation is measured against. The MEASUREMENT_LEGEND route - it defines the vocabulary and never says what to conclude.

outputs.name: audio_mix_spec
outputs.description: State output: audio_mix_spec - the track levels, the per-block music automation carrying the solved clip gain and the separation it delivers, what the bed measures, the dialogue cleanup the plan asked for (requests plus the per-source noise table it was decided over), and `value_decisions`: what decided each level, on what basis, over which measurements (library/tools/decided_value.py).

outputs.name: cleanup_context
outputs.description: Bridge output: one noise row per played source - the ranges the edit plays, the floor rung 5a measures, the speech level, and what each cleanup tool can do on this run. It is the table the cleanup half of the prompt reads, and the measurement the plan's `why` must cite.

llm_outputs.name: cleanup_plan
llm_outputs.description: Dialogue cleanup - which played sources get noise treatment, with which tool. Each: source (a source_file basename from cleanup_context.sources - no other value names anything the build can stage), tool (voice_isolation - Resolve's per-track Voice Isolation applied at build with read-back - or deepfilternet - a processed stem the build places natively; no other value reaches any code), amount (REQUIRED for voice_isolation: Resolve's own 0..100 scale, the strength the measured floor made right; FORBIDDEN for deepfilternet, which has no strength dial), span_start/span_end (OPTIONAL pair in source seconds cleaning only that span; leave both out and the whole played range is cleaned), why (REQUIRED - what in the measured floor made this tool and this amount the answer). An entry that names no tool the vocabulary holds, no amount where one is required, or no why is refused and re-planned, never defaulted. Leave the list empty when no source earns it - silence here is a decision, and the build cleans nothing it was not asked for.
